levels.headline: UV is low
levels.explanation: For most people, routine sun protection is generally not needed at low UV levels.
actions: Bright reflective surroundings, such as fresh snow, can increase UV exposure.

levels.headline: Sun protection is recommended
levels.explanation: At these UV levels, unprotected skin and eyes can be harmed. Protection helps reduce exposure.
actions: Seek shade when UV is strongest.
Cover skin with clothing, and wear a brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses.
Use broad-spectrum sunscreen on skin clothing does not cover; follow its label.

levels.headline: Extra protection is important
levels.explanation: UV is very strong during this outing, so unprotected skin and eyes can be harmed more quickly.
actions: Seek shade and limit exposure when UV is strongest.
Cover skin with clothing, and wear a brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses.
Use broad-spectrum sunscreen on skin clothing does not cover; follow its label.

shadeMessages.message: Your outing is mostly exposed to open sun, so shade may be limited.
Your outing includes mostly sun with some shaded sections; protect yourself during exposed parts.
Your outing alternates between sun and shade. Shade helps, but scattered and reflected UV can still reach you.
Overhead cover helps reduce exposure, but it does not block all scattered or reflected UV.
